name: EIN FESTE BURG
source: Open Hymnal Project ABC scores (rhythmic and isometric forms) consulted; hymnary.org incipit 1 1 1 5 6 7 1 7 6 5.
reviewNotes: No melody yet: add it from a hymn book you trust (see docs/BLOG.md, "Adding a hymn"), then set the hymn's draft to false. Why it is not encoded: the tune is printed in two different rhythms (Luther's rhythmic form, unbarred, and the even-note isometric form), and the Open Hymnal's isometric version is altered to fit Hedge's words. Encode the form your choir's book uses.
